units: <cite ref="Gittin 69b:18">Gitt. 69ᵇ</cite> <he>אס׳ יבישתא</he> on a dry twig.—[<cite ref="Pesachim 4a">Pes. 4ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="A02441"><he>אֲסִיסְנָא</he></cite>.]
Sabb. 110ᵃ וסימניך ס̇יס̇ני Ms. M. (ed. סִיסָאנֵי) and thy mnemonical catchword be sisâné (i.e. יוס̇ף ס̇ערי R. Joseph mentioned (שערי) barley).
